system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: meghdoot_get_alert_history and meghdoot_raise_grievance. For your information, my description is dummy_description_8358, my time_window is dummy_time_window_8108, my grievance_category is dummy_grievance_category_8730, my aadhaar_number is 100020009910, my location is dummy_location_7076.

function.name: meghdoot_get_alert_history
function.description: Retrieves historical alerts for a location over a specified period. PUBLIC tool. Only recent history available. Does NOT show currently active alerts — use meghdoot_get_weather_alert. Fails if location is invalid or no historical data exists.

function.name: meghdoot_raise_grievance
function.description: Raises a grievance about alerts. Valid categories: 'alert_not_received', 'incorrect_alert', 'delayed_alert', 'location_mismatch', 'notification_failure'. Must verify alert availability first. Requires session_token. Fails if category is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for subscription and grievance tools.
